entry.title: How to write well.
entry.content: It is easy to write, I am doing it right now. It is not easy to write well. Unfortunately I do not write well, this post is to serve myself as much as it is to serve any passerby. During my time as a PhD student I have had to write many papers and the advice of my advisor often gets lost in a bundle of notes. For my own sake I have bundled them here. This is not a style guide or latex tips, for those I recommend the stanford style guide for LaTeX which focusses on how to write math in LaTeX as well as many tips for writing well.
entry.summary: Some lessons I've taken from my advisor on how to write in a way that is easy to understand.
